patterns.note: The primary content is presented in a narrow, centrally aligned text column that overlays a full-bleed, dynamic background image.
A multi-layered background image, composed of electronic components, parallaxes and subtly zooms as the user scrolls, creating a deep, immersive visual field behind the main text content.
A large, pixelated 'opal' brand name graphic gradually reveals from the bottom of the viewport, fading in and growing to fill the screen as the user scrolls past the primary narrative.
A fixed header containing the brand logo and a fixed footer with navigation links remain visible at the top and bottom of the screen, respectively, throughout the scroll.
The site uses a clear typographic hierarchy with a large, bold hero title, moderately sized headings, and legible body text, all in a sans-serif font.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-triggered animation system, likely utilizing a canvas or video background, where a detailed collage of product imagery exhibits multi-layered parallax and subtle zoom effects, creating a dynamic sense of depth as the user scrolls.
A large, pixelated brand name graphic is revealed with a staggered fade-in and scale effect as the user scrolls past the main content, serving as a powerful visual conclusion to the page.
The header and footer elements are sticky, maintaining their position at the top and bottom of the viewport, providing persistent branding and navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: The hero title is significantly oversized and bold (~4x body), while headings are moderately larger and bolder (~1.5-2x body) than the standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp — all visible elements and containers feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced — text lines and paragraphs are well-spaced for readability, and the central content column maintains a comfortable width, while the hero section utilizes ample vertical space.

standout: The distinctive use of a full-bleed, multi-layered product collage as a dynamic, parallaxing background creates a rich, immersive, and almost tactile experience that visually grounds the narrative content. The subtle, large pixelated brand name reveal at the end is also unique.
